sentences.text: In a quiet city, emotions are gone.
A boy named Leo lives here.
One day, Leo finds a book.
He talks to his friend, Mia.
"We must not talk about feelings," she says.
He sees people in the dark.
They want to change the city.
The government does not like feelings.
The government punishes people who feel.
In the end, Leo chooses to fight.
They plan to change the city.
They plan to bring back feelings.
